basics.name: Leonard Phillips
basics.label: AI and integration engineer
basics.summary:
I build plugins and skills that let AI coding agents like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot work reliably on real business systems, with automatic checks on everything they produce and a person signing off anything that cannot be undone.

Behind that sit seven years of connecting the systems businesses run on: NetSuite development in New Zealand, integration consulting in the Netherlands, and AI-built platforms for Boomi as a sole trader.

custom.headline: AI agent plugins and integrations · Claude Code and GitHub Copilot · Boomi, NetSuite
custom.availability: Open to contract and permanent roles in AI and integration engineering, remote from New Zealand.

work.name: Sahara Software
work.position: Sole trader, AI and integration engineer
work.summary: My own business, for clients in New Zealand and Australia. On contract to a large European construction company, working remotely from New Zealand. Across this engagement and my earlier secondment there, with LLMs doing much of the coding and my own design, checks and approval around it:
highlights: Built Testify, an automated regression testing platform for Boomi, live in production.

Built Fathom, a plugin for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI, with its own skills, hooks and toolchain, that lets AI agents build Boomi integrations safely. The client's integration developers use it for their integration work.
Designed a monitoring platform for Boomi in the client's own Azure, on OpenTelemetry and Grafana and defined entirely as code, in development and validated end to end in a sandbox.
Built agent-dashboard, an open-source dashboard for the usage, cost and plan limits of Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.

work.name: Emixa
work.summary: Seconded to a large European construction company from January 2024, working with Boomi, Solace, Azure API Management, Salesforce and ServiceNow.
highlights: Designed RESTful APIs with OpenAPI v3 in Azure API Management, secured with OAuth 2.0 and backed by Boomi, that gave third-party applications controlled access to residential construction data that security policy barred them from reaching directly.
Designed a JSON-RPC 2.0 API with a Boomi backend, decoupled so that a new remote procedure needs no redeployment of the API or the backend.
Designed an event-driven integration that carries ServiceNow changes to three other systems, with a routing layer that mimics Solace, so only that layer changes when Solace goes live.
Designed a decoupled logging framework in Boomi, so a logging failure never stops the business process it records.
Became lead maintainer of the open-source Solace Queue Message Viewer, a Solace-managed repository, and demoed it as a guest speaker at the Solace Community lightning talks in January 2025.
